== Title ==
<span lang="ja">キャッシーク</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
'''Light''' — <span lang="ja">ここには自分のウーキーと密輸屋を配備コスト－2で配備できる。</span>

'''Dark''' — <span lang="ja">ここで戦闘運命数を引くためには合計で6以上の能力値が必要。</span>

== Lore ==
The card has no printed lore box.

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Kashyyyk]].

'''Lore''' — The card has no printed lore box.

'''Game text''' — The printed game-text box is blank.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Light text says you may deploy your Wookiees and smugglers here at deploy cost -2. English says those cards deploy -2 here. Dark text matches the English ability-6 battle destiny requirement.<ref>[[:File:ANH-L-kashyyyk.gif|Original English face]], [[Kashyyyk]].</ref>
